units: <cite ref="Shabbat 63a">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אם ת״ח חָגְרֵיהוּ על מתנך …</he> if a scholar be even revengeful … like a serpent, bind him around thy loins (be not afraid of him).
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:1">Midd. III, 1</cite> <he>וחוט … חוֹגְרוֹ וכ׳</he> and a red line went around it.—

XXV, 21</cite>)? <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43">Ex. R. s. 43</cite>, beg. <he>התחיל חוֹגֵר בתפלה</he> (sub. <he>מתניו</he>) he began to pray boldly.
